items.title: ITSM Training Courses for the US Defense

details.label: Objective
details.text: To enhance the knowledge and skills of IT support personnel in ITSM practices to improve service management and delivery.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: The onsite training in Miami over 6 months combined interactive lectures, group discussions, and hands-on exercises for ITSM concepts.

details.label: Participants
details.text: 170 IT support personnel from the US Defense took up the training.

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: Participants gained a comprehensive understanding of ITSM principles, enabling streamlined IT service management and enhanced operational efficiency.

quote.text: The ITSM training provided by Edstellar was instrumental in equipping our team with the necessary skills to improve our IT management processes. The interactive methodology and practical exercises were particularly beneficial.
quote.name: James Anderson

items.title: Agile Project Management and ITSM Training for Renowned Space Agency in India

details.label: Objective
details.text: To equip space agency scientists and engineers with leadership skills, project management, ITSM, MS Office proficiency, and DevOps practices.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: The onsite training in Hyderabad included interactive lectures, hands-on exercises, and real-world case studies for practical application of concepts.

details.label: Participants
details.text: Approximately 50 scientists and engineers from the renowned space agency.

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: The skills helped improve team dynamics, enhanced service quality, streamlined project management, and accelerated software delivery for better overall performance.

quote.text: Edstellar's on-site training greatly helped improve our team's skills and collaboration. Training scheduling challenges were addressed and the support during the training engagement was great.
quote.name: Dr. Anil Kumar

items.title: DevOps and Microsoft Azure Training Programs for US Defense in Japan

details.label: Objective
details.text: To enhance IT administrators' and project managers' skills in DevOps and Azure, improving cloud management and deployment efficiency for military operations.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: Onsite training in Yokohama included interactive lectures, hands-on labs, and group activities for practical DevOps and Azure administration.

details.label: Participants
details.text: Approximately 100 IT personnel from the US Defense.

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: Participants gained comprehensive DevOps and Azure knowledge, streamlining IT operations, improving cloud management, and enhancing system reliability for critical defense operations.

quote.text: Partnering with Edstellar for DevOps and Azure training significantly upskilled our IT team, improving efficiency in cloud management. The tailored, practical training approach was especially beneficial for the team.
quote.name: Michael Thompson

items.title: Professional Scrum Training for Educational Department, Ireland

details.label: Objective
details.text: To equip project managers and administrators with Agile skills, improving project management and product development practices and outcomes.

details.label: Training Methodology
details.text: The training, delivered via VILT, used interactive lectures, case studies, and exercises to ensure the team gained practical knowledge of Scrum principles.

details.label: Participants
details.text: Approximately 120 project managers and education administrators from the Educational Department, Ireland.

details.label: Learning Outcome
details.text: Participants gained deeper understanding of Agile project management, which helps strengthen the Scrum roles, and improves workflows. The training contributed to better team collaboration, leading to improved project outcomes.

quote.text: Edstellar's Agile project management training was highly impactful. The vILT delivery was engaging, enhancing our team's grasp of Scrum practices and it improved our project management efficiency.
quote.name: Sarah Mitchell
